import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int mn = 0;
        int mx = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int x = scanner.nextInt();
            if (i == 0) {
                mn = mx = x;
            } else {
                if (x < mn) {
                    mn = x;
                }
                if (x > mx) {
                    mx = x;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(mn + (mx - mn) / 2);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
